conflict_synopsis.core_view: Do not fade the USDCAD grind: 1d/5d/1m spot, a still-widening CA-US front-end spread, and post-FOMC global tightening are aligned.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Fed tightening bias and Broader G10 tightening keep CA-US 2Y moving against CAD, extending the 5d/1m USDCAD trend.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: USDCAD 5d and 1m returns both turn negative while CA-US 2Y stops moving against CAD, or BoC policy closes the hawkish US-CA gap.

remit: persistent price and macro trends; reject premature fades
stance_summary: Do not fade the USDCAD grind: 1d/5d/1m spot, the still-widening CA-US front-end spread, and post-FOMC global tightening are aligned, and energy ToT is not a reversal signal.

catalysts: Fed tightening bias remaining intact after the 25bp hike
Global tightening persistence (BoJ hike, hawkish BoE split/QT)
Canadian labor/wage cooling versus still-restrictive US front-end yields
Energy shock constraining a global easing impulse
trade.invalidation: USDCAD 5d and 1m returns both turn negative while the CA-US 2Y spread stops moving against CAD, or Canadian core inflation/BoC policy closes the hawkish US-CA gap.
trade.mispricing: Market pricing still treats CAD energy support and the 3m CAD outperformance as enough to fade USDCAD, even though the live 5d/1m price path, CA-US 2Y/5Y/10Y spread trend, and Fed-versus-BoC policy gap remain USD-positive.
principal_risks: CAD terms-of-trade support from retained crude-near-$110 research
Q2 Canadian activity/consumer gauges still above 50
ECB FX and official yields are research/reference only
trade.thesis: The post-hike USD-over-CAD trend continues while US-CA policy and front-end spreads still move against CAD. USDCAD research/reference returns are positive on 1d, 5d and 1m; CA-US 2Y is -140bp and still widening against CAD; Fed hiked 25bp and August CPI kept a tightening bias. Spot has not fully transmitted the already-extreme rate-spread trend. USDJPY is not the continuation: 1m return is negative and the BoJ hike is a potential regime break.
why_now: Fed hike is delivered and the Sep 18 desk thesis says global tightening broadened via BoJ hike and a hawkish BoE hold.
CA-US 2Y widened a further ~15bp against CAD over 5d and ~17bp over 1m, matching USDCAD +1.10% 5d and +1.74% 1m.
Canada August core is near target and labor is cooling, so a BoC catch-up hike is not the live catalyst.
